Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished production environment background for Pit Stack, a premium retro Formula 1 falling-block browser game. Create ONE full-bleed landscape 3:2 scene, not a collage or sprite sheet. Not vector graphics, not flat polygons, not photorealism, no blur. Composition: a wide scenic view from inside the racing paddock beside the circuit; recognizable landmarks in the left and right outer thirds and upper sky so they remain visible around a tall opaque game board over the central 40 percent. Continue a real fully illustrated scene through the centre, do not draw a blank rectangle. Foreground asphalt, tyre barriers, red-white kerbs and subtle pit-lane equipment at lower edges; a few small open-wheel race cars near the edges. Landmark silhouettes must read on a phone portrait centre crop too: some architecture high above the horizon. No UI, no game board, no tetris blocks, no letters, no captions, no watermarks, no sponsor logos. Natural crisp retro pixels with beautiful readable silhouettes, art-directed as one cohesive ten-venue series.
